OCR Engine & Script Mode

Open a PDF to choose pages.

Run OCR sends the selected page images through Sefer Pro’s OCR service to the selected provider. Provider charges may apply. Use your SoferStudio access key for this session.

Akiva OCR reads each page twice over: a whole-page view for columns, zones and reading order, and close-up tiles at full scan resolution for every letter, nikkud mark and Rashi-script form. Footnotes come after the body under ---.

Sofer.Ai returns its own reading order. Select Hybrid to review column order against the image. Adding nikkud here uses Gemini and sends the extracted text to Google.

Run OCR sends each page image to the connected OCR service.

Use the service access code, not a provider API key. It stays in this page session. A private connection file fills these fields locally; loading it sends nothing.

Connect your OCR service to enable vision recognition.
SoferStudio access for text tools

Rashi script uses a specialized on-device model. Review square Hebrew headings, page numbers, and references; they can still be misread.

Run continues unfinished pages. Saved results are kept even if you change engine, language, or quality; Rescan replaces them for one run. Save an OCR session before closing, reloading, opening another PDF, or changing PDF pages.

Ready to scan current PDF page.

Review footnote labels, page numbers, and references against the scan. Engine confidence is not measured accuracy.

Review suggested items

Choose an item to compare it with the scan. A possible missed header has no text to select. Unflagged text may also need correction.

Save or resume OCR work

Save all page text, corrections, review notes, and searchable positions in an OCR session. Later, open the same PDF and restore the session; Run continues unfinished pages. Current page results are kept when restoring.

Keep the session and its source PDF together. Download the matching source after merging, rotating, inserting, or deleting pages. The session does not include the PDF or annotations; it excludes service access codes.

OCR work stays in this tab until you save a session.
Searchable PDF

Replace existing text layer (keeps scanned appearance). Exports the selected pages with matched on-device OCR. Pages become lossless images at the OCR resolution; original links, forms, and vector content are flattened. Studio annotations and footnotes are included.

Single-word corrections keep their positions. Larger rewrites or AI text need new word positions; TXT remains available.
